time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 = t 0; frame = round(t * fps)
description: Sunset sky over city apartment buildings (Lisbon-like, red metro 'M' sign). A single twin-engine narrow-body airliner (B737-type silhouette, dark against the sky, landing gear down) flies left-to-right in side view across the upper-middle of the frame, slightly climbing in the image, and leaves through the right edge. Hand-held camera with a slow smooth pan right/tilt up; no zoom.
units: pixels and seconds; no metric scale is assumed

objects.name: airplane
objects.distinguish: only aircraft / only moving object; dark silhouette against the sky; nose points right, gear down, near-side wing drawn up-left above the fuselage
objects.reference_point: bbox centre (cx_bbox, cy_bbox) while fully visible (0-88); tail tip x0 is valid all frames 0-105; nose tip x1 valid only 0-88
objects.apparent_size_change: bbox length grows ~24% (328 -> 406 px) over frames 0-88, roughly linearly (~0.9 px/frame); the plane is approaching the camera / getting closer as it passes
objects.motion_direction: rightwards, main axis a few degrees from horizontal (nose slightly up); bbox centre moves from (1757,866) at f0 to (3602,837) at f88 in raw image coords
